x_living_wage_bcd48e_01.desc: The federal minimum wage has stayed at $7.25 for years. Should Congress finally raise it?

x_living_wage_bcd48e_02.desc: A full-time job should at least put basic living costs within reach. What would a workable policy look like?

x_living_wage_bcd48e_03.desc: Raising the minimum wage sounds simple until you ask how small businesses will absorb it.

x_living_wage_bcd48e_04.desc: Minimum wage policy should account for inflation instead of waiting years for a political fight. Curious how others see this.

x_living_wage_bcd48e_05.desc: Can one national wage floor reflect the cost of living in both rural towns and big cities?

x_living_wage_bcd48e_06.desc: Workers should not need multiple jobs just to cover essentials.

x_living_wage_bcd48e_07.desc: Would a gradual federal minimum wage increase be easier for employers to manage?

x_living_wage_bcd48e_08.desc: Higher wages help workers, but what happens to prices and hiring? We need that debate too.

x_living_wage_bcd48e_09.desc: The conversation is not just about paychecks. It is about what full-time work can buy.

x_living_wage_bcd48e_10.desc: Should the federal minimum wage be indexed to a cost-of-living measure? Thoughts?

x_living_wage_bcd48e_11.desc: Cities already set different wage floors. Does the country still need a stronger federal baseline?

x_living_wage_bcd48e_12.desc: A minimum wage that never changes effectively loses value every year prices rise.

x_living_wage_bcd48e_13.desc: Service-sector workers are central to the wage debate, but their experiences are not identical.

x_living_wage_bcd48e_14.desc: Could tax credits for small employers ease the transition to a higher minimum wage? Anyone seen this handled well locally?

x_living_wage_bcd48e_15.desc: The wage floor should be high enough to matter without ignoring regional differences.

x_living_wage_bcd48e_16.desc: Why is it easier to debate a number than to talk to people actually earning it?

x_living_wage_bcd48e_17.desc: Does raising the minimum wage reduce poverty, or do housing costs eat up the gains?

x_living_wage_bcd48e_18.desc: Young and entry-level workers deserve a realistic path to better wages.

x_living_wage_bcd48e_19.desc: If a business depends on extremely low wages, what does that say about its model?

x_living_wage_bcd48e_20.desc: What federal minimum wage would you support, and why that amount?
